places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: The herd camps west of town; most of the crew go carousing and find Jake gambling and snubbing them, then return badly hungover.
places.location_hint: herd camp just west of Fort Worth, a couple of miles out

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: The herd crosses it without trouble while Gus is still away.

places.name: Trinity River
places.note: Crossed after the Brazos, still with no sign of Gus.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call wishes he had told Jake there that the girl would not be coming along.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Call figures it will be the next town the outfit sees after Fort Worth.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Jasper jokes about cold rivers before reaching it; Newt puts off the Raineys' request until then.

places.name: Red River
places.note: Ben fears drowning in it; Dish calls it the next excitement ahead.

places.name: Llano Estacado
places.note: Po Campo once raised sheep there until Blue Duck killed his three sons; Call recalls its unnerving emptiness and fears Gus has vanished there.

places.name: Ireland
places.note: Allen says he got daily practice at hangovers back there.

places.name: China
places.note: Needle tells hungover Jasper he can walk there for all anyone cares.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: herd moving north from its camp west of Fort Worth toward the Red River
